title: Tetrahydropyridines: a recent update for their multicomponent synthesis

Transcription (THPs) are important nitrogen heterocycles present in many natural and synthetic bioactive molecules. This review summarises diverse multicomponent synthetic strategies for the efficient construction of THP derivatives.
